title: Month Name from Number

content.problemStatement: Write a program to print the respective month name based on given input

solution.approach: Map month number (1=January ... 12=December) to month name, else 'Invalid'.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Check 1 <= m <= 12 and print month name, otherwise print 'Invalid'.

hints: Check if month is between 1 and 12.
Map 1 to January, 2 to February, etc.
